|translation='''Title:''' Image Of The Dark Lord.

'''Card text:'''
When the opponent is generating at least 3 Force more than you, spend 4 Force to deploy at any location. At that location and adjacent locations, a player with no presence there cannot generate Force.

'''Lore:'''
Vader’s hologram exacts absolute loyalty from his legions.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face names only that location and adjacent locations.
